BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning

Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the Ml-1 Limited

Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols as shown on Map No. 5-H

in the area bounded by:



The south right-of-way line of Bloomingdale trail park; North Paulina Street; The

public alley next south of and parallel to vacated West Bloomingdale Avenue; and the

public alley next west of and parallel to North Paulina Street,



To those of a Bl-l Neighborhood District.



SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common address of property: 1754 N. Paulina Street
                                 Narrative and Plans for Type 1
                              Rezonitm of 1754 N. Paulina Street
                             From Ml-1 Distriet to a B1-1 District



    A. Proposed land use:
       Seeking to rezone property from Ml-1 to B1-1 in order to use the existing 1 story
building for a preschool, daycare facility.

   B. The project's floor area ratio (FAR) will be 1.2. Actual 0.79.

   C. The project's density is zero. There are no dwelling units.

   D. The amount of off-street parking will be 13 parking spaces.

   E. Setbacks Existing:

       Front: 0'

       North: 2.58'

       Rear: 0'

       South: 20'

   F. The existing building height is 20'- 3" high.

The applicant will comply with 17-3-0307 exceptions of the Chicago Air Quality Ordinance

should such provisions be detennined as applicable.
